title: Generalized Advantage Estimation
signature: def gae(rewards: np.ndarray, values: np.ndarray, dones: np.ndarray, last_value, gamma: float = 0.99, lam: float = 0.95) -> tuple
hints: Append last_value to values so V(s_{t+1}) is always values_ext[t + 1].
delta_t = r_t + gamma * (1 - done_t) * V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t). The mask is done_t, the flag for the same step, not done_{t+1}.
Loop backward: A_t = delta_t + gamma * lam * (1 - done_t) * A_{t+1}. The mask cuts the recursion at episode boundaries.
returns = advantages + values. Index time on axis 0 and the same code works for (T,) and (T, N).
